name: How is wall prep handled before installing a new tile or marble backsplash?

mainEntity.name: How is wall prep handled before installing a new tile or marble backsplash?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tile and marble installations require clean, flat, and structurally sound backer boards, which often means repairing or replacing water-damaged drywall before setting tile. Setting backsplash or floor tile over uneven surfaces leads to lippage, cracking, or failed grout joints over time. During a remodel, finish crews inspect substrate integrity, hang cement board or moisture-resistant drywall, and verify proper expansion gaps against countertops. Working with a finish contractor skilled in both drywall repair and stone installation ensures transitions between painted walls, trim molding, and tile borders remain crisp and structurally sound.
acceptedAnswer.description: Damaged drywall is removed or repaired, surfaces are leveled, and moisture-resistant backer board is installed to create a flat, durable surface for clean tile and grout application.
